request.summary: Add a single opt-in config toggle (default off) that gates the plugin's existing private, client-side-only chatbox alerts about events - both the T-3h/T-1h/T-5min milestone reminders and the once-per-session "here's what you're signed up for" summary.
request.raw_requirements:
Add an opt-in config toggle for the plugin's existing in-game chat message alerts about events.

Current behavior (CatastrophicEventsPlugin.java): the plugin already pushes private, client-side-only chatbox messages (via ChatMessageManager/sendClientMessage - nothing sent to the game server, nothing shared with anyone else) for two things, both currently always-on with no config gate:
1. checkReminderMilestones/sendReminder - milestone reminders at T-3h/T-1h/T-5min for events the player is signed up for, deduped per event+milestone.
2. announceSignedUpEvents - a once-per-client-session "here's what you're signed up for" summary fired on the first successful poll.

Requested change: add a config checkbox so these are opt-in (default off), consistent in spirit with how lootSharingEnabled/deathScreenshotsEnabled work in CatastrophicEventsConfig.java, gating both sendReminder and announceSignedUpEvents behind a single new toggle (both go through the same sendClientMessage mechanism, so one toggle covers both). This is purely a client-side/local feature - no Discord or catabot involvement, unlike the loot/death/coffer alerts.

plan.approach: Add one new boolean @ConfigItem to CatastrophicEventsConfig.java (matching the lootSharingEnabled/deathScreenshotsEnabled pattern), then gate both checkReminderMilestones(...) and announceSignedUpEvents(...) in CatastrophicEventsPlugin.java behind it with a single early-return check in each - no changes needed to the poll-loop call sites themselves.
steps: Step 1 - CatastrophicEventsConfig.java: add @ConfigItem(position = 5, keyName = "eventRemindersEnabled", name = "Event chat reminders", ...), default false, description covering both the T-3h/T-1h/T-5min milestone reminders and the once-per-session signed-up-events summary.

Step 2 - CatastrophicEventsPlugin.java: add an early-return `if (!config.eventRemindersEnabled()) { return; }` at the top of checkReminderMilestones(List<EventDto> events) and at the top of announceSignedUpEvents(List<EventDto> events).
Step 3 - README.md: update the config-panel bullet under "What's implemented" and the reminders bullet to note this is now opt-in (default off).

Step 4 - Manual QA: ./gradlew compileJava to confirm it compiles clean. No live game session available in this environment - confirming reminders stay silent when off and fire correctly when on is on the developer before shipping.

verification.notes: Definition of done confirmed by developer (all 4 plan steps complete, conventions followed, no unit tests since no test framework exists in this repo - TD-001, no staging branch in use here). Concerns check: no new concerns - purely local/client-side gate on existing logic. Dev UAT confirmed by developer, based on the live ./gradlew run session against this exact branch's changes earlier in the day.
